subject: Promo stacking: accelerator voucher -> dedicated conversion for Helix Springboard
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@helixlabs.co>
Date: 2025-11-17T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Promo stacking: accelerator voucher -> dedicated conversion for Helix Springboard

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the demo last week — great conversation. Quick follow up from our side on the Springboard cohort: I understand Helix has a $25k accelerator voucher that you’d like to apply toward production usage. Two asks from your note: can we (1) stack that voucher with sandbox credits for onboarding, and (2) convert any unused voucher value into a production (Dedicated) discount if you decide to go that route?

Short answer: yes — we have a standard conversion pathway but it needs a small finance/legal sign-off to finalize. To kick things off I attached a short MAP (helix_MAP_draft.pdf) and a draft conversion rubric so your procurement can see the options. High level options we typically offer: 
- Apply voucher as one-time invoice credit at onboarding (easy, no commit)
- Convert voucher into a time-limited Dedicated discount (e.g., equivalent credit applied as a 3–6 month % discount on a reserved pool) — requires a minimal month-to-month committed pool for compatibility with reserved capacity pricing

Can you confirm which approach you prefer and, if conversion, an estimate of expected peak monthly token/embedding consumption so we can size the dedicated pool vs. the invoice credit? If helpful I can loop in Finance/Legal to speed the approval.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-min call if procurement wants a quick walkthrough.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

Attachments: helix_MAP_draft.pdf
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@helixlabs.co>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-17T12:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Promo stacking: accelerator voucher -> dedicated conversion for Helix Springboard

Marissa,

Appreciate the quick follow-up and the MAP. We definitely want to stack the voucher with onboarding sandbox credits so our engineers can iterate quickly. The preferred outcome for the exec team is to have the voucher count toward a pilot that can convert to reserved capacity if we see production lift. Procurement will want: clear equivalence (voucher value -> % discount / committed amount), contract language for a one-time conversion, and confirmation of any billing/tax implications.

Estimated consumption for initial 3 months (proof of concept + alpha): ~1.2M tokens / month with occasional embedding lookups. If we scale to a pilot (month 4–6) we expect ~4–5M tokens / month.

Can you put numbers against those two profiles (POC vs pilot) and confirm whether the Dedicated conversion will require a multi-month minimum commit? Also, we need to see SOC2 evidence and a short note on key management — is customer-managed keys supported?

Procurement contact is procurement@helixlabs.co (cc’ing).

Thanks,
Alex Rivera
Head of Platform — Helix Labs
alex.rivera@helixlabs.co
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@helixlabs.co>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-17T15:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Promo stacking: accelerator voucher -> dedicated conversion for Helix Springboard

Thanks Alex — looping in Ben (Finance) and Laura (Legal) to confirm the operational details.

Numbers (back-of-envelope) based on your consumption profiles and our pricing bands:
- POC profile (~1.2M tokens/mo): sandbox credits cover onboarding; converted voucher could be taken as a one-time invoice credit equal to $25k (no commit).
- Pilot profile (~4–5M tokens/mo): conversion option = apply $25k voucher as a 6-month discount spread across a reserved pool. Example conversion rubric we recommend: $25k voucher = ~20% discount on a reserved pool sized at $7k/mo for 6 months (note: reserved pricing requires a min commit; in this example we'd request a $7k/mo commitment). That equates to approx a $25k gross value absorbed as a time-limited discount.

Options summary for procurement:
1) Invoice credit: simplest. Voucher applied to first invoice(s) until exhausted; no reserved commit required.
2) Dedicated conversion: Voucher converted into an upfront-equivalent discount applied monthly against a reserved pool (requires a committed pool for the term; we typically support 3–12 month terms).

Attachments: credit_conversion_calc.xlsx (detailed example calculations for both profiles) and a slightly updated MAP (helix_MAP_draft.pdf).

On SOC2 / KMS: we can provide our SOC2 Type II attestation and security pack within 48 hours. For Key Management: Redwood Private supports customer-managed keys (HSM/KMS integrations) on Private deployments; for Hosted/Dedicated we offer bring-your-own-KMS via our enterprise integrations — Laura, please weigh in if we should provide formal language for the SOW.

Next steps: Alex — tell us which option procurement prefers and whether they will raise a PO (if Dedicated conversion, we'll issue a short amendment and also send a DocuSign for signature). We can also provide a quick 15-min exec walkthrough if that helps move things along.

Best,
Marissa

Attachments: credit_conversion_calc.xlsx, helix_MAP_draft.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@helixlabs.co>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: accounting@redwood.com
Date: 2025-11-18T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Promo stacking: accelerator voucher -> dedicated conversion for Helix Springboard

Marissa / Alex — quick note from Finance: provisional approval for the conversion rubric above. If Helix elects Dedicated conversion, we will need a PO referencing deal HLX-2025-07 and a billing contact for invoicing. Tax treatment will follow the PO jurisdiction and we’ll surface any tax withholding requirements at invoicing time.

If you want the voucher to be a one-time invoice credit instead, we can process that faster (no PO required), but it cannot be later converted into a committed discount without an amendment and retroactive accounting adjustments.

Ben Carter
Sr. Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@helixlabs.co>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@helixlabs.co>
Date: 2025-11-20T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Promo stacking: accelerator voucher -> dedicated conversion for Helix Springboard

Marissa / Ben — thanks for the clarity. Procurement is fine with the two-path approach. Their preference is to try the POC with sandbox credits and, assuming we hit pilot thresholds, convert the voucher into the Dedicated discount for months 4–9 under a 6-month committed pool.

Procurement will raise a PO for the committed pool once we confirm the exact monthly size — I’ve asked them to review the credit_conversion_calc.xlsx and will route a PO to your accounting address once they have sign-off. Two small asks before we proceed: 
- Can you send the SOC2 pack and a short security annex regarding KMS? (procurement asked for explicit supported KMS models)
- Please include a one-page amendment template we can forward to our legal team to speed signature (we can probably sign via DocuSign).

Procurement contact for PO: procurement@helixlabs.co. I’ll also introduce Samir (CTO) if they have technical questions.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — we should be able to close the conversion path in the next 7–10 business days after procurement reviews the calc.

Best,
Alex Rivera
Head of Platform — Helix Labs
